text: Whey is mostly water, so it is evaporated first and then dried. The key step is lactose crystallisation before drying; without it the powder is a hygroscopic lump. The handbook gives no dryer temperatures.

steps.note: Cooled or pasteurised first so it does not ferment.
Flash-cooled to start lactose crystals, then held in crystallisers.
Spray-dried; drum drying exists, with bran as filler.
